01-01.title: The Act of Union takes effect
01-01.summary: Great Britain and Ireland are formally united into the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.

01-24.title: Gold is discovered at Sutter's Mill
01-24.summary: James W. Marshall finds gold in California, helping trigger the California Gold Rush.

02-14.title: Bell applies for the telephone patent
02-14.summary: Alexander Graham Bell submits the patent application that becomes central to the early history of the telephone.

03-14.title: Albert Einstein is born
03-14.summary: The physicist Albert Einstein is born in Ulm in the Kingdom of Wurttemberg.

03-14.title: NASA photographs Pluto's surface
03-14.summary: The Hubble Space Telescope captures images that help reveal large-scale brightness differences on Pluto.

04-12.title: Yuri Gagarin orbits Earth
04-12.summary: Vostok 1 carries Yuri Gagarin into orbit, making him the first human in space.

05-05.title: Alan Shepard reaches space
05-05.summary: Freedom 7 lifts Alan Shepard on a suborbital mission, the first American spaceflight.

06-16.title: Valentina Tereshkova launches into space
06-16.summary: Vostok 6 carries Valentina Tereshkova, the first woman to fly in space.

07-20.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
07-20.summary: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin land in the Sea of Tranquility during humanity's first crewed lunar landing.

08-15.title: The Panama Canal opens
08-15.summary: The SS Ancon becomes the first ship to transit the Panama Canal after the official opening.

09-12.title: Luna 2 reaches the Moon
09-12.summary: The Soviet Luna 2 mission becomes the first human-made object to reach the Moon.

10-04.title: Sputnik 1 launches
10-04.summary: The Soviet Union launches Sputnik 1, the first artificial Earth satellite.

11-09.title: The Berlin Wall opens
11-09.summary: East German authorities announce that citizens may cross the Berlin Wall, accelerating German reunification.

12-17.title: The Wright Flyer takes off
12-17.summary: Orville and Wilbur Wright complete the first controlled, sustained flight of a powered aircraft.
